purpose: Teach: クイーン/神戸大学/日本テレビ/ヤマハ/セルビア/養老/慶應義塾/中国共産党

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクイーンのコンサート映像を観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was watching Queen concert footage.
lines.style: Warm, informational. Casual delivery, like she's sharing a small domestic detail. Slight smile in the voice. Not performing the moment, just noticing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと神戸大学の見学に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to tour Kobe University with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, direct excitement. Quick tempo. Voice rises at the end — he wants her to know it mattered. Genuine enthusiasm without needing approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが日本テレビの番組に出演されるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — apparently your dad is appearing on a Nittele program.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact delivery. Slightly impressed but underplayed. She's sharing news that's notable but routine in this household. Measured pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとヤマハのピアノ展示見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw the Yamaha piano exhibition with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate. Quick-paced, eager to share. Voice bounces slightly — he's proud of the memory. Wants her full attention for this detail.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがセルビアの友人と再会されたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad reconnected with an old friend from Serbia.
lines.style: Measured, conversational. Gentle interest in her voice — she finds this detail worth sharing with him. Steady pacing, no rush. Warm observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと養老の滝の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Yoro Falls!
lines.style: Bright, direct excitement. Quick tempo with slight breathiness — he's moved by this memory. Open, happy voice. Wants her to share in the moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが慶應義塾大学で講演されるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — apparently your dad is giving a lecture at Keio University.
lines.style: Calm, informational. She's sharing domestic news with affection underneath. No performance — just the small pride of knowing her husband's achievements. Steady, quiet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと中国共産党のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about the Chinese Communist Party together!
lines.style: Bright, direct energy. Quick-paced, eager. Voice carries genuine pleasure — he's sharing something he absorbed with his dad. Warm and immediate closure.
